avocado.note: USDA portion: "1 avocado, NS as to Florida or California" = 201 g

pita.note: USDA portion: "1 pita, large (6-1/2\" dia)" = 64 g each; package is 6 pitas = 384 g

garlic.note: assumption: 1 head ≈ 10 cloves × 3 g (USDA "1 clove" = 3 g)

cabbage.note: USDA portion: "1 head, medium (about 5-3/4\" dia)" = 908 g

cauliflower.note: USDA portion: "1 head medium (5-6\" dia.)" = 588 g

celery.note: assumption: 1 bunch ≈ 9 medium stalks × 40 g (USDA "1 stalk, medium" = 40 g)

onion.note: USDA portion: "1 medium (2-1/2\" dia)" = 110 g; store onions are medium, not large

red_onion.note: USDA portion: "1 medium (2-1/2\" dia)" = 110 g; store onions are medium, not large

bell_pepper.note: USDA portion: "1 medium (approx 2-3/4\" long, 2-1/2 dia.)" = 119 g
